jd:
Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us.

Our Information Security team within Corporate IT is looking for an intern to support AI-enabled security engineering initiatives. This position provides the opportunity to gain hands-on experience applying artificial intelligence, automation, software development, and security engineering practices while completing your education.

Duties & Responsibilities



- Assist with developing, testing, and documenting AI-enabled security tools, workflows, and prototypes
- Use scripting and APIs to automate security engineering tasks, data collection, enrichment, analysis, and reporting
- Support the integration and evaluation of security technologies across cloud, identity, endpoint, network, and data environments
- Analyze security data to identify patterns, anomalies, potential threats, and opportunities to improve controls
- Help assess the security of AI solutions, including access controls, data protection, prompt and model risks, and responsible-use safeguards
- Build and maintain technical documentation, test plans, code repositories, and repeatable engineering procedures
- Collaborate with security engineers and internal stakeholders to define requirements, troubleshoot issues, demonstrate solutions, and deliver project outcomes

Required Skills & Experience



- Education: Currently enrolled in a degree program in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field
- Foundational knowledge of cybersecurity concepts such as identity and access management, cloud security, endpoint security, networking, secure software development, or threat detection
- Intermediate programming or scripting language skill, such as Python, PowerShell, JavaScript, or C#
- Understanding of AI and machine learning concepts, large language models, or data analysis
- Ability to troubleshoot technical problems, learn unfamiliar technologies, and take ownership through resolution
- Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively while sharing knowledge as part of a team
- Ability to manage time, prioritize tasks, and communicate technical information clearly in writing and conversation

Preferred Skills & Experience



- Academic, personal, or work projects involving generative AI, machine learning, security automation, or data engineering
- Experience using APIs, Git-based development workflows, notebooks, or development environments
- Knowledge of security capabilities within Microsoft Azure or Microsoft 365, including identity, endpoint, cloud, or security monitoring technologies
- Exposure to cloud platforms, containers, Linux, infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines, or policy as code
- Understanding of secure coding, threat modeling, vulnerability management, or common security frameworks
- Experience working with structured or unstructured security data and creating useful analyses or visualizations

Travel: 1 - 10%

Physical Demands: This is a typical office job, with no special physical requirements or unusual work environment.

Duration & Location: Start ASAP, part-time hours during the academic year (~20-25 hrs), full-time 40 hours per week Summer 2027. This is not a remote position. Preference for candidate to be in Liberty Lake, WA.

Liberty Lake, WA: hourly, state minimum up to $44.23/hr

Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for!

The successful candidate's starting wage will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience.

Itron is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you require an accommodation to apply, please contact a recruiting representative at 1-800-635-5461 or email Accessibility@itron.com.

Itron is transforming how the world manages energy, water and city services. Our trusted intelligent infrastructure solutions help utilities and cities improve efficiency, build resilience and deliver safe, reliable and affordable service. With edge intelligence, we connect people, data insights and devices so communities can better manage the essential resources they rely on to live. Join us as we create a more resourceful world: www.itron.com
fit_why: Security-focused AI intern; strong Python/AI overlap, weak security background

role: AI & Innovation Specialist (Internship) – ALTO project / Cadence
jd:
SYSTRA Canada is part of the SYSTRA group, an international consulting and engineering group, a world leader in the design of transport infrastructures. SYSTRA Canada is an engineering and consulting firm whose primary focus is to offer transportation solutions, whether for passengers or goods: feasibility studies of building a new railway line, increasing the capacity of the existing infrastructure, privatization of a railway.

Context

The Digital team leads the ALTO project’s Innovation and Artificial Intelligence program to identify, test, and deploy solutions aimed at improving project performance, team efficiency, and knowledge management.

The AI & Innovation Specialist will contribute to driving the Innovation program and to expanding AI use cases across the entire project.

Missions/Main Duties

Artificial Intelligence



- Identify and analyze AI use cases in collaboration with business teams.
- Support the deployment of generative AI and automation tools.
- Contribute to the development of demos and proof-of-concept projects.
- Measure productivity gains and the benefits of deployed initiatives.
- Contribute to AI governance and best practices for AI use.

Innovation



- Conduct strategic and technology watch activities.
- Help coordinate the portfolio of innovation initiatives.
- Organize ideation and co-creation workshops with teams.
- Contribute to relationships with technology partners, universities, and research centres.
- Prepare presentations for governance committees.

Profile/Skills



- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, civil engineering, or urban planning.
- Strong interest in AI, digital transformation, and innovation.
- Knowledge of Microsoft 365 tools, Power Platform, and generative AI solutions.
- Ability to explain technical concepts in clear, accessible terms.
- Excellent communication skills in both French and English.
-  Reasons for requiring bilingualism: You will have the opportunity to work with a varied clientele, including both French- and English-speaking companies. Bilingualism is therefore fundamental to building strong relationships with our customers, understanding their specific needs, communicating effectively in their preferred language and facilitating strategic meetings.

SYSTRA Canada is committed to having a diverse and inclusive workforce. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer that values applications from all and offers employment equity based on the merits and abilities of candidates and personnel.

We use AI-enabled tools in our recruitment platform (iCIMS) for tasks like resume parsing and candidate matching. These tools do not make hiring decisions; all applications are reviewed by a human recruiter, and final decisions are made by our hiring team.For questions about our hiring process or AI tools, please contact [email protected].

Note: In this description, the masculine gender is used for easy reading purposes and includes the feminine.

Workplace Type

Hybrid
